findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to different tenants. This removes the function’s sole authorization boundary and can expose tenant-isolated data; the result must remain conditional on the user and document tenants matching.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 353aa4f622e3029d73dab67a4aa388af74b430fa, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this directly replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so the claimed trusted-admin restriction is not enforced by this function and the cross-tenant authorization bypass remains.
